facts.text: New Jersey undergraduate students can reduce college tuition costs by up to 100 percent through Bridging the Gap and the Garden State Guarantee.

sources.title: Cost and Financial Aid | Rutgers University-Camden
sources.quote: New Jersey undergraduate students can reduce their college costs by up to 100% at Rutgers University–Camden. Through Bridging the Gap, supplemented by the Garden State Guarantee, you can greatly decrease or completely avoid student loan debt
